title: Rainy Office with Painting
description: A dimly lit security office interior with a desk, lit lamp, white cup, open book, and a blue jacket draped over a chair. Heavy rain falls from a glass ceiling. A large surreal painting dominates the right wall, depicting a long decaying green hallway with red exit signs, bloody handprints, and flickering fluorescent lights.
prompt: A moody cinematic scene of a rainy security office at night with water pouring through a glass ceiling. On the left, a desk holds a lit blue lamp, white coffee cup, open book, and a blue jacket hangs on the chair. A large painting on the purple wall shows a long decaying institutional hallway with green peeling walls, red glowing exit signs, bloody handprints, and fluorescent lights. Dark, unsettling atmosphere, heavy rain, realistic details.
